advisories.text: IfRange.check is not tested with a naive last_modified or an If-Range holding a weak ETag, but neither is a required behaviour.
ETagSet.from_header already discarded invalid unquoted values, and etag.py is unchanged, so this test only locks in existing behaviour.

coverage.note: Parametrized cases cover strong, weak, str, mismatched and missing ETags, matching dates, dates differing by a second, microsecond truncation, and an empty IfRange.

Covers clamping of stop and suffix, first range only, unsatisfiable, zero, unknown and empty cases. The from_header rejection cases are in test_range_from_header_invalid and test_content_range_from_header_invalid.
Asserts unquoted foo, bar, baz and the malformed `"c" x` are discarded while quoted values are kept. The behaviour already existed before this task.

advisories.text: No test covers If-Match (or a star If-Match) when the response has no ETag, nor a failing If-Match combined with If-None-Match, so the ordering of the 412 check before the 304 check is unproven.
The `if_none_match.star_tag` and `if_match.star_tag` branches could be folded into a small helper, but this is cosmetic.

coverage.note: Precedence tests, per-method If-Match tests and the no_headers Accept-Ranges assertion together cover the RFC order and the header.
412 on unsafe methods, 304 on GET/HEAD, and the entity headers removed from the 304 are each asserted.
Star ETag is tested with exists True and False for both If-Match and If-None-Match, with different outcomes.
The non-GET, non-200, unknown/zero length and non-bytes unit cases are each tested, and each asserts Accept-Ranges.
First-range-only, clamping, suffix, unsatisfiable and basic 206 are all asserted, including Content-Length, Content-Range and data.
Matching, mismatching and weak ETags are tested, plus the date match and mismatch in the sibling test.

advisories.text: mtime detection from a file object is only asserted as `last_modified is not None`; no test checks the value equals the file's mtime or that an ETag is generated for a file object, and no test checks that an explicit download_name overrides a named file's name.
The `path_name` temporary can be folded into one expression, e.g. `if download_name is None and isinstance(name, str): download_name = os.path.basename(name)`.

coverage.note: Reads a BytesIO and a real file to the end, then asserts the full data is sent. test_object_range (line 114) checks Content-Range and length after a partial read. test_object_detects_name_size_mtime (line 66) checks size.
Asserts the ETag equals exactly `"{mtime}-{size}"`, so a path hash would fail it.

A BytesIO with no name gives application/octet-stream instead of TypeError. Routing through apply_conditions/apply_range is exercised by test_etag_conditional_not_modified (line 155, 304) and test_path_range_and_accept_ranges (206).

advisories.text: No test covers If-Range, HEAD, or a Range request combined with a conditional header through the middleware; these are exercised only indirectly via send_file tests.
generate_etag (and its adler32 import) is no longer used by __call__; it is kept as a public method, so removal is optional.
No existing test was weakened; the diff only adds tests.

coverage.note: Asserts 304 via If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since. test_range asserts 206 with Content-Range, and test_no_default_cache_timeout asserts there is no max-age or Expires by default.
pytest.deprecated_call wraps fallback_mimetype, and the value is still honoured. test_cache_false_deprecated covers the cache parameter the same way.

advisories.text: `_LM =datetime(...)` lost the space after `=`. This is an unrelated formatting regression that `ruff format` will flag; restore `_LM = datetime(...)`.

`test_invalid_range_request` was changed from `bytes=-` to `bytes=20-30`. The new `test_malformed_range_request_ignored` covers the old input with the new behaviour, so no case is lost, but the behaviour change (416 to 200) is only documented in a comment.

`make_conditional` now sets `content_length = complete_length` whenever `complete_length` is truthy, even with no range. The old code set it only for a 206. This is tested, but it is a silent behaviour change for a deprecated method.

coverage.note: Asserts the DeprecationWarning. The retained make_conditional tests (etag 304/412, range requests) exercise the apply_conditions and apply_range path under the warning filter.

Checks the warning and the unchanged return values for each parametrized case. `test_is_resource_modified_deprecated` checks the warning for `is_resource_modified`, and the existing `is_resource_modified` tests still check its results.
Old tests were kept under targeted `filterwarnings` markers rather than deleted, so the existing assertions still run. The harness reports the whole suite green.

advisories.text: Changelog omits that ETagSet.from_header now discards invalid unquoted values, a behaviour change from the plan.
